mechanism_analysis.mechanism_supported.reason: The empirical-ablation alternative is met: SMART removes the distance boost, maximin removes the variance factor, and beta sensitivity varies boost strength while holding the surrogate and optimizer fixed. Ten-seed logged comparisons support the contribution of the space-filling component on diffusion.

mechanism_analysis.surrogate_vs_acquisit.reason: BVS does not introduce a surrogate change relative to the submitted SMART/gSMART baselines: all use the same GPOptimizer construction, exponential kernel, variogram fit, and update path. failure_analysis.subsection_present.reason: Section 6.2 is explicitly devoted to where BVS does not help and why.

failure_analysis.patterns_identified.reason: The discussion groups small BVS gains on the four 2D cases, gradient-weighting failures on discontinuous surfaces, and intermediate-budget grid advantages caused by lattice alignment.

failure_analysis.patterns_explained_cohe.reason: The central explanation exceeds what its mathematics and experiments establish. Comparing a few CVT and feature-aware designs does not bound all acquisitions, and an interpolating exponential-kernel surrogate has no demonstrated transition-width lower bound equal to its length scale. The related claim that a long correlation length makes posterior variance saturate near the sill also reverses the relevant short-correlation argument. These claims do not establish the asserted unavoidable 2D failure regime.
